name: Image generation — direct endpoint
summary: Direct call to POST /openai/v1/images/generations with a BYOM-prefixed model name.
description: Probes whether the images endpoint parses the '{conn}/{model}' prefix as a route hint. Research suggests the model param is required and treated literally, so BYOM is likely inapplicable here. Test documents the actual behavior.
notes: Likely fails because the images endpoint does not parse the BYOM prefix. Captured as a gap. Confirmed broken: direct images endpoint does not parse the BYOM prefix.
